description: This file is a client-side API utility module for interacting with a Strapi backend, providing functions for feature flag checks, base URL configuration, query building, and making GET requests to the API.
external_files: node-fetch (implied by use of fetch in environment supporting fetch, or runtime environment)

methods.name: isFeatureEnabled(flag)
methods.description: Checks if a feature flag is enabled based on environment variable REACT_APP_FEATURE_FLAGS.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variables, with a fallback to a default Strapi demo URL.

methods.name: buildQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Constructs a query string from parameters, supporting nested objects and arrays for filtering and population.

methods.name: strapiGet(path, { params, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the Strapi backend with the specified path and parameters.
